J3.unknown_for_manufacturer_class: Original Hirose DM3AT-SF-PEJM5 drawing is still not archived (direct download 403), so the mouth plane and card travel cannot be cited to a manufacturer page or figure and no travel_nm is declared. The 15 mm lane stays a D-PCB-13 engineering value, distinct from the catalog positions. Thermal: the J3 manufacturer maximum temperature is still to be verified from an original; no thermal claim is made.

part_identity.footprint_description_error: KiCad footprint Connector_Card:microSD_HC_Hirose_DM3AT-SF-PEJM5 describes push-pull; the Hirose DM3 catalog D49662_en lists this exact part as PUSH-PUSH.

catalog_common_datum_positions_mm.source_class: web_extracted_secondary (indexed catalog text, no original hash)
catalog_common_datum_positions_mm.meaning: Differences of manufacturer positions on a common drawing datum. NOT full card removal travel and NOT finger clearance; not used as travel_nm. The catalog may state that engineering drawings take precedence.

mouth_datum_verification.text: The mouth datum (library y 8.88 declared, 8.90 probe) is NOT manufacturer-verified: the exact-part drawing endpoint (https://www.hirose.com/product/download/?distributor=chip1&lang=en&num=DM3AT-SF-PEJM5&type=2d, six pages stamped Oct.1.2026) gave 403 on direct download and only boilerplate through web extraction. The 0.02 mm claimed lane defect therefore stays an unresolved measurement; it is not authorization to move J3 and J3 stays fixed.

J1.direction_source: TE drawing 776163 rev K1 (telemetry-pod/expansion/connector-candidate/sources/776163-K1.pdf, sha256 7ed1f2a5f6ebf57aeaefefa4b2bf5c165de0343a4317719d7771c2aabbc285a7): sheet 1 section A-A and sheet 2 isometric 'AMPSEAL HEADER' / 'RECOMMENDED P.C. BOARD LAYOUT' show a right-angle header whose mating mouth is parallel to the board, toward the board edge past pin row 24-35. In the footprint frame (F, rotation 0; pad 1 y=51.5, pad 35 y=59.5 in iter8n/iter8s) that is outward y+.

revision_history.note: identifies current documentation; no immutable version pin for the latest HTML

source_figure.orientation: Preserve the figure's feed-point orientation when mapping to the board; this is NOT a symmetric 15 mm PCB blanket.
source_figure.separate_recommendation: Text separately recommends >= 15 mm housing clearance in all directions and final range/throughput tests. It is a manufacturer recommendation, not a board qualification.
source_figure.board_application: Applying these values to this board's U1 pose and feed orientation still needs review.

U3.reason: NEO-M9N has no on-board antenna; the GNSS antenna is external on SMA J2 (REQUIREMENTS.md), covered by the J2 entry.

source_packet.provenance_note: Hirose, TE and Molex content was retrieved through web-indexed or extracted text ONLY (class 'web_extracted_secondary'); direct PDF downloads returned 403 or timed out, so there are no original hashes and these are NOT manufacturer-original citations. Espressif HTML and PNG originals were retrieved and are hashed (class 'manufacturer_original_hashed'). Nothing here is promoted to a manufacturer-class declaration and no travel is inferred.
source_packet.diagnostic_only_note: The check.py runs are DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. The J3 mouth datum is not manufacturer-verified and the runner supplies no fixed-overhang policy, so the resulting hard_fail cannot establish design acceptance, design rejection or a compulsory move, and does not authorize moving J3.
